noncePlan.note: one factory call per contract; the broadcaster nonce sequence is irrelevant because addresses derive from CREATE2

roleOwnership.description: Protocol governance is the timelock; no EOA may hold upgrade, parameter, or treasury authority.
roleOwnership.mechanism: ModuleRegistry.GOVERNANCE_ROLE and EmergencyControls.GOVERNANCE_ROLE are held by the timelock custody slot.

roleOwnership.description: Minimum 172800s delay on every governed action including module replacement and governed unpause.
roleOwnership.mechanism: Timelock custody slot executes all grants, replacements, and unpause resolutions.

roleOwnership.description: Guardian can veto/pause but can never mutate the module registry or unpause unilaterally.
roleOwnership.mechanism: GUARDIAN_ROLE on ModuleRegistry and PAUSER_ROLE on EvidenceRegistry.

roleOwnership.description: No proxy admin and no retained deployer upgrade authority; module replacement is the only upgrade path.
roleOwnership.mechanism: ModuleRegistry replacement requires GOVERNANCE_ROLE plus a 172800s timelock; DEPLOYMENT_ROLE is renounced at finalization.

roleOwnership.description: Claim fees and treasury flows route to the treasury custody slot, never to the deployer.
Pause initiation and resolution are split across two separate custody slots.
roleOwnership.mechanism: EmergencyGatekeeper.PAUSE_INITIATOR (initiator) and PAUSE_RESOLVER (resolver) with a 3600s rewire delay.

commands.reproduce: git clean -xdf -e node_modules && npm ci && forge build && npx hardhat compile && node scripts/check-optimism-sepolia-release.mjs --with-artifacts

rollback.pause: EmergencyGatekeeper.pause(scope) by PAUSE_INITIATOR — scope-bounded, never protocol-wide by default.
rollback.unpause: Governed unpause only: the timelock executes EmergencyGatekeeper.resolve(scope) after the 172800s delay; the guardian cannot unpause.
rollback.roleTransfer: Re-run the finalization grant/renounce sequence, then `forge script script/deploy/VerifyRoleRenunciation.s.sol` against the canonical address set.
rollback.upgradeRollback: Before execution call ModuleRegistry.cancelModuleReplacement(moduleId); after execution re-register the previous implementation (GOVERNANCE_ROLE + 172800s timelock). Storage layouts are frozen by storage-layouts/manifest.json.
rollback.recovery: Follow docs/runbooks/rollback.md: pause the affected scope, restore the previous release package by releaseId, replay events from the pinned eventStartCursor, and verify roles with PostDeploymentRoleCheck.

blockers: External custody slots (bootstrapAdmin, timelock, guardian, emergencyCouncil, treasury, pauseInitiator, pauseResolver, upgradeAdmin, releasePublisher) are unassigned until the maintainer supplies Optimism Sepolia owner addresses.
